captionStarter: Broncos 30-26 over the Rams. Down 16-0 at halftime, won it with 47 seconds left.
concept: Split-screen: Rams fans at halftime up 16-0 / same fans after Stafford's final-play interception
description: Bo Nix's goal-line keeper with 47 seconds left and a 66-yard Talanoa Hufanga pick-six lifted Denver past the Rams 30-26 after trailing 16-0 at halftime.
headline: Broncos erase 16-0 halftime hole, beat Rams 30-26 on Sunday night
